raw_segments.text: Romeo, alas that love whose view is muffled still should without eyes see pathways to
his will. Where shall we dine? O me, what fray was here? Yet tell me not, for I have
heard it all. Here's much to do with hate but more with love. Why then, O brawling love,
O loving hate, O anything of nothing first create, O heavy lightness, serious vanity,
Misshape in chaos of well-seeming forms, Feather of lead, bright smoke, cold fire, sick
health, Still waking sleep, that is not what it is.
This love feel I, that feel no love in this. Dost thou not laugh?
